snippet.title: Siege Update Preview - Dwarf Fortress Update
snippet.description:
Gameplay from the upcoming siege update for Dwarf Fortress. Buy on Steam: https://bit.ly/2PY0P0w

You can see the new sprites with trolls wearing equipment, showing a enemy siege formation. There’s also a defensive formation with crossbow turrets firing at an incoming charge up a hill.

Music: Sisters of War - Dabu, Simon Swerwer
Cover art: Thea Kent

➫Join the Official Dwarf Fortress Discord: https://bit.ly/3W1HvfX
➫Sign up for Dwarf Mail: https://bit.ly/3uYfudW
